name: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A half marathon (21.1km, plus 10km and 5km options) held in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia on September 20, 2026.
ai_summary: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 is set for September 20, 2026 in Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia, offering three distance options: 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half marathon as the primary event. It is organized by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), with execution handled by RAW Organizer and Runaway Lampung. Registration is currently open, though the exact start point for the race has not yet been announced.

core_facts.venue: Bandar Lampung (exact start point not yet announced)

excerpt_quotes.attribution: AKP Agustina Nilawati (Bandar Lampung Police PR) on the 2025 Locomotive Run, Tribratanews Polda Lampung

research_highlights: The 2026 edition adds a 21K half-marathon distance alongside 5K and 10K categories, per event listing on schedules.run.
The race is scheduled for Sunday, September 20, 2026 in Bandar Lampung, organized by Raw Organizer / Runaway Lampung.
Previous 'Locomotive Run' editions (April 2025) started and finished at Tanjungkarang railway station, routing past city landmarks ('Icon Kota Bandar Lampung') before returning to the station.
Past editions drew over 2,000 participants including KAI employees, running communities, the general public, and a disability category from Yayasan Harapan Masa Depan Lampung.
Along the route in prior editions, organizers provided music entertainment, water stations, and cheer zones ('zona cheer up') to support runners.
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports or reviews for the half-marathon (21K) distance were found, since prior 'Locomotive Run' editions only offered 5K/10K/3K categories — this appears to be the event's first year including a half-marathon.

Local police mobilized traffic control personnel along the route for the 2025 edition, indicating runners and spectators should expect road closures/traffic management around the Tanjungkarang station area.

faqs.question: When is the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled for September 20, 2026. It will take place in Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia. Registration is currently open for runners interested in taking part, giving participants time to prepare and secure their spot before the race weekend arrives.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers three distance options: a 5km, a 10km, and a 21.1km half marathon, which serves as the primary distance. This range allows both casual participants and more experienced runners to choose a distance that matches their fitness level and racing goals for the day.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 is organized by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the national railway company, with event execution handled by RAW Organizer together with Runaway Lampung. This partnership brings together a major national organization and local race organizers to deliver the event in Bandar Lampung.

faqs.question: Where exactly does the race start?
faqs.answer: The race will be held in Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia, though the exact start point has not yet been announced by the organizers. Runners planning to participate should keep checking official updates from PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) and RAW Organizer / Runaway Lampung for further venue details.
